rights_findings: Dukascopy website data is not being automated because current terms prohibit scraper/robot/data-mining acquisition without prior written consent.
FRED SP500 is not being used in the cloud pipeline because it is third-party copyrighted and current FRED terms impose additional AI/storage restrictions.
Investing.com OSE Nikkei Mini history is useful as a daily sanity source only, not as minute-data validation.

JPX explicitly states that historical OSE tick data may be provided for trading-methodology examination under certain conditions; published free-trial procedure describes a company applicant, so individual eligibility and permitted retention/cloud processing remain unresolved.
Multiple public projects document the SGX WEBPXTICK historical endpoint, but current SGX automation/non-display/retention rights are not sufficiently established for bulk acquisition.

225Labo currently states Nikkei 225 mini minute data are available from 2006 and Nikkei 225 micro minute data from 2023-07-24 in 1/3/5/10/15/20/30/60-minute intervals. Registered-member downloads are free, licensed to the downloader only, and third-party provision/sale or similar transfer is prohibited. Raw files therefore remain local-only in this project.
